review.analysis: The requirement specifies software behavior for the SFMC upon receiving a subsystem fault report. It clearly defines the trigger (a monitored subsystem reporting a fault), the required software action (displaying the affected subsystem and reported fault to the pilot), and a specific, testable timing constraint (within 1 second). No defects were identified, so quality_status is ACCEPTABLE and quality_issues is empty. Since displaying fault information is an ordinary monitoring/reporting function without an automated protective interlock or transition to a safe state, no SWE-184 link is included.
review.summary: SFMC-REQ-027 is a well-defined software requirement that specifies the display of reported subsystem faults to the pilot within a 1-second timing threshold.
